name: ir-transduce-nested

transduce.source:
; The transducer part of the grammar ir-transduce-nested: the JSON events of the value
; its @object and @array annotations build, from its rule passes, as
; tabnas-bnf wrote them from the value actions those annotations attach.
def ir-transduce-nested-transduce [input]
  transduce-tree
    record
      entry :inner (record (entry :container :object) (entry :member "maj") (entry :text true))
      entry :inner$step1 (record (entry :container :object) (entry :member "min") (entry :text true))
      entry :top (record (entry :container :object) (entry :member "name") (entry :text true))
      entry :top$step1 (record (entry :container :object) (entry :member "inner"))
    input
